targets.evidence_need: Recover the labels/series/panel relationships needed to determine which plain and residual network depths are compared and how the chart distinguishes training/test error.
annotated_facts: The figure contains three error-vs-iteration panels.
The left panel is plain networks and includes plain-20, plain-32, plain-44, and plain-56.
The middle panel is ResNets and includes ResNet-20, ResNet-32, ResNet-44, ResNet-56, and ResNet-110.
The right panel compares very deep residual networks including residual-110 and residual-1202.
Dashed curves denote training error and bold curves denote testing error.

targets.evidence_need: Recover the architecture labels and shortcut relationships needed to distinguish VGG-19, the 34-layer plain network, and the 34-layer residual network.
annotated_facts: The figure compares three architectures: VGG-19, a 34-layer plain network, and a 34-layer residual network.
The residual architecture contains shortcut connections absent from the plain counterpart.
Dotted shortcuts are used where dimensions increase.
The 34-layer plain and 34-layer residual networks each have 3.6 billion FLOPs, versus 19.6 billion FLOPs for VGG-19.
